_comment: Coverage floors (#532/#587). Up-only under test:ratchet. Floors move to two points below a level sustained for three runs; absolute floor-lag remains visible in the report.
approvedDeviation: @vitest/coverage-v8 4 (#565) made AST-aware remapping the only mode, redefining what counts as a branch (optional chaining, nullish coalescing, default params, nested arrows). This is a MEASUREMENT change, not lost coverage — proven by packages/tunnel, packages/backup, packages/agent-runtime and packages/cli, which have ZERO source or test changes vs origin/main yet all moved (tunnel branches 80 -> 52.67). Local and CI agree within 0.06pt, so it is deterministic, not runner variance. Branch floors re-seed ~1pt under the newly measured values; the vault/tunnel/cli LINE floors move 1-3pt for the same reason. NOT re-seeded downward: packages/design-tokens lines TIGHTENS 90 -> 98, because #565 added packages/design-tokens/src/css.test.ts covering toCss(), which had 0/32 lines and no test anywhere in the repo — that gap, not the remap, was the entire design-tokens lines miss (66.01 -> 99.03). Issue #630 deliberately expands the global denominator by 11,639 executable blueprint app/kit lines that the old 71% never measured. The final complete issue tree measures 63.05%, so the aggregate seeds at 62 with one point of runner/remapping headroom while the two newly visible scopes retain their own higher measured floors and ratchet upward. No previously instrumented file lost coverage. PR #638 re-seeds packages/vault and packages/gateway line floors 1pt under the honest measured tip (vault 87.7/73.9 → 87/73, gateway 79.9 → 79) after #630 vault expansion (locker-auth, schedule-organize, recurrence, household) diluted the old mainline 88/80 seeds; tests for those surfaces were added in the same change.
